Overview

Zlín is a city in with a population of 75,000. A unique Moravian city shaped by the Bata shoe company, featuring distinctive functionalist architecture and a strong industrial design heritage. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
